Save game is not compatible.
If you want to continue with the old one, download it from the beta tab, tagged old_version.

notes.title: My new game is out!
notes.notes:
You can still get "She turned me into a newt" at a discount of 30%!

However, I'd like to call your attention to my new game too.

[b]"DaCapo Delivers" has been launched. Take advantage of the launch discount of 15% and put your hands on your very own copy![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1537930/DaCapo_Delivers/

Supports 7 languages! (English, Magyar, German, Italian, Spanish, French, Russian)

Time Management, Stock Management, Quick Decisions, Math Training, Memory Training, Priority Setting, Fast Paced, Vintage Ambience, Light Mood
Set in the 1930s, in a nameless city very much like Chicago, you play as Sal DaCapo, a young man with ambitions. Start by supplying groceries to Mom and Pop's Pasta Place and Speakeasy while you case the scene. Don't be deceived by the first training levels, you'll be speeding along juggling your money and stock soon enough. An aspiring mob boss needs an incredible amount of supplies to support his mob and his gold-digger girlfriend, and there's only limited time to do it or go broke.  

If you find any issue (localization for instance) or have a question, send me an e-mail: teleportgameshq@gmail.com
